svg.title: ThingsBoard release-3.6 - failure recovery and observability

g.text: Provider commit methods are not equivalent
The queue is non-durable and the message is non-persistent.
The producer does not enable publisher confirms.
basicAck directly sends a method frame; its return is not a broker
acknowledgement. A normal return therefore does not prove durable confirm.
The common commit() name does not make remote acknowledgement synchronous.
Provider redelivery, visibility timeout, ack deadline, and channel state remain provider-specific.
